newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch bourse-listed firms 1996 profits up four pct.
newsitem.headline: Dutch bourse-listed firms 1996 profits up four pct.

text.p: The net profits of 120 Dutch bourse-listed companies rose by 1.3 billion guilders or four percent to a total of 32.9 billion guilders in 1996, the Central Bureau of Statistics (CBS) said on Tuesday.
"CBS figures indicate that the high profit levels of the previous two years were slightly exceeded," the bureau said, adding that trends in various business sectors showed wide differences.
Total 1996 turnover of the 120 companies surveyed grew by 14 percent to 631.5 billion guilders.
Financial firms posted 1996 total profits of 8.4 billion guilders, up 25 percent from 1995, and profits in the services sector surged by 39 percent to 0.6 billion guilders.
But in the manufacturing sector profits fell by four percent to 19.4 billion guilders, mainly because of strong decreases in the machinery and electronics segments, the CBS said.
Only 10 of the 120 companies suffered a loss in 1996, the same number as in 1995, but their total loss rose to 0.7 billion guilders from 0.1 billion in 1995.
